prompt:
Create a complete high-fidelity desktop UI concept at 1600x1000 landscape for Molis Work PROJECT HOME, concept B “Time leaves a trace”. Use the provided onboarding screenshot ONLY as reference for quiet large whitespace, low-weight Chinese type, sentence-like inputs. Palette must follow user’s latest direction: neutral white #ffffff main page, pale #f8f9fb sidebar, charcoal #272932, secondary #60636f, tiny violet #6262d6 accent. No green cast, brown, beige, illustrations, photography, decorative gradients. A usable application screen, NOT a motivational poster.
STRUCTURE: fixed 220px sidebar at left, subtle project identity Molis Work · 开发预览 and quiet nav 项目首页 selected, Goals, Sessions, Feed, Artifacts; settings low at bottom. Thin 32px topbar says 项目首页. Main content is a large expansive horizontal TIME composition with asymmetric typography. At main upper left around x330 y160, modest dateline “2026年9月12日 · 星期六”. Below at x330 y250 restrained large Chinese two-line headline “做过的事，\n会留下回声。” at about 38px, no giant hero date. To its far right at x1140 y300 tiny quotation “不积跬步，无以至千里。” with attribution “荀子 ·《劝学》” and delicate carousel controls below.
The defining structure around y510 is a single continuous hairline across the page, a real recent-activity timeline from older work on left to today on right. Exactly three small grounded points on this line, timestamp labels above: “周四”, “昨天”, “今天 09:42”; short distinct work titles below: “建立项目的第一个目标”, “接通终端与目标信息”, “体验新的 Goal 工作区”. Last point in subtle violet, others gray. Thin line continues into blank future space towards the right. This line represents actual work timestamps, not charts or decorative fake metrics; no axes or sparklines. Each event has enough space, long title wraps to two lines at most, no boxes.
Below the timeline around y700, an active but calm one-line composer begins “下一步，我想” then underline with placeholder “接着写下今天想推进的事…” and a small understated arrow button, width about 650px. Tiny “草稿保留在当前会话 · Agent 即将接入”. A quiet “查看工作记录 →” rests in the lower-right. Considered asymmetry and huge breathing room, restrained operational clarity. No dashboard KPI cards, no data tables, no piled lists. All five elements date, quotation, activity, composer and sidebar visible. All Chinese text crisp and intentional; no concept label or explanation overlays, no watermark.
